description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which is part of a logging system allowing multiple logging targets to be chained together. It specifies a method for outputting log data with various levels of detail.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain, capable of outputting log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
